aoi.name: Mekong Agricultural Belt
aoi.description: Intensive smallholder crop-residue burning (maize, rice stubble). Unharmonized raw counts jump +380% after VIIRS launch in 2012 because 375 m pixels detect small agricultural burns that 1 km MODIS missed; harmonization bridges the discontinuity and isolates true elevated activity.
